fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header, or with Accept-Encoding: identity, and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that accepts gzip can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.
stability_check: First downloaded on 2026-09-25 at 12:31Z by the researcher and downloaded again at 13:07Z; the independent check downloaded it again at 13:14-13:18Z with Accept-Encoding: identity. Every download had the same byte count and SHA-256. Downloaded again for this packet at 2026-09-25T15:31Z (integration pass) with the same byte count and SHA-256.
provenance_note: Raw Internet Archive capture (id_ form) of the original page, captured at 2024-07-03T02:27:51Z (before the 7 September 2026 cutoff); that form replays the archived bytes unchanged and is used in place of the live page. Fetched without Accept-Encoding (curl without --compressed), the archive serves it uncompressed: the recorded byte count and SHA-256 are those of the uncompressed body. The response identity was confirmed by downloads at least 30 minutes apart (see stability_check). This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, PDFs and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.

rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The Presidency's advisory, page-dated 1 July 2024, invites the media to the swearing-in of the new Deputy President, Cabinet Ministers and Deputy Ministers on Wednesday 3 July 2024 at the Cape Town International Convention Centre (CTICC2, Hall 8), 10h00 for 11h00, with Chief Justice Raymond Zondo presiding; it recalls that the President announced the members on Sunday 30 June 2024.

bounded_scope: Deputy President observations for CLAUDE-C01-21 only (role za_deputy_president in za_presidency). Announcements, stated intentions, appointments and their notices, oaths and their scheduling, stated assumptions, releases, resignations and their stated effect, Assembly-seat events and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder observations and any start or end are decided in the packet, not by any row. The President's roles (za_president_election, za_state_president) and the ANC's party office are excluded and no row feeds them.
